# Modules

Every feature of the harness is a module. Each page here is read from the
module's source (see `lisp/harness-module-docs.el`): what it provides to
the others and what it uses of them. `scripts/module-docs.sh` writes them
again; `M-x harness-describe-module` shows one in Emacs.

## Choosing modules

The modules marked *by default* below always load: the core
(`harness-core-modules`) and what comes with it. The others load when
your init file enables them, after `(require 'harness)`: copy this,
uncomment the modules you want, and restart the harness. A module
brings along what it requires and its UI (tasks loads the task board,
ui-tasks); `(setq harness-enabled-modules t)` loads every module.

## The harness process

| Module | Loaded | Requires | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| [access](access.md) | by default | [perms](perms.md), [session](session.md), [tools](tools.md), [readonly](readonly.md) | What a session may reach, in one place: its access profile (network, writing, tools, read-only and given-up directories, the Linux capabilities of its commands), request_escalation, which only the user answers, drop_access, which never asks, and the record of every permission judgement. |
| [acp](acp.md) | by default |  | Agent Client Protocol: local and TCP transports, server and client. |
| [acp-remote](acp-remote.md) |  | [acp](acp.md) | ACP for phones and other devices on the network: WebSocket, sign-in by approval in Emacs or OpenID Connect, session secrets. |
| [agent](agent.md) | by default | [session](session.md), [provider](provider.md), [tools](tools.md) | The turn loop: prompt, stream, run tools, steer, queue. |
| [cache](cache.md) |  | [session](session.md) | Watches the sessions' prompt caches and says when one is about to lapse (cache/pre-expire), and whether the user is around. |
| [cache-compact](cache-compact.md) |  | [session](session.md), [compaction](compaction.md), [cache](cache.md), [cowboy](cowboy.md) | Compacts a conversation just before its prompt cache lapses, while it is still hot in it, as the user saved for a cold cache and where they would not be asked. |
| [cache-warm](cache-warm.md) |  | [session](session.md), [provider](provider.md), [agent](agent.md), [cache](cache.md) | Keeps a session's prompt cache warm while its user is around or a tool runs: reads it again just before it lapses, for as long as that costs less than sending the conversation again. |
| [commit-msg](commit-msg.md) |  | [config](config.md), [worktree](worktree.md) | A commit-msg hook stripping Claude attribution, in the repositories that turn it on. |
| [compaction](compaction.md) | by default | [session](session.md), [provider](provider.md), [agent](agent.md) | Summarise the transcript when it nears the context window; queue or interrupt one while a turn runs. |
| [config](config.md) | by default | [project](project.md) | Layered settings through customize and dir-locals. |
| [cost-compare](cost-compare.md) |  | [usage](usage.md), [provider](provider.md) | What the recorded usage would have cost at other models' prices. |
| [cowboy](cowboy.md) |  | [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md), [compaction](compaction.md) | Ask what goes first when a message meets a session whose prompt cache went cold. |
| [decisions](decisions.md) |  | [store](store.md) | Lasting decisions -- answers that hold beyond their moment -- with their undo and redo, from any session. |
| [fallback](fallback.md) |  | [store](store.md), [session](session.md), [provider](provider.md) | Carry on with another provider when one runs out of quota or money. |
| [handoff](handoff.md) |  | [session](session.md), [provider](provider.md), [agent](agent.md) | Warn before a lossy switch to a hosted-loop provider, and hand the conversation over. |
| [insights](insights.md) |  | [store](store.md) | The Insights report: figures and a written summary of the work, for any provider. |
| [judge](judge.md) |  |  | Judges: one-off questions to the simple tier of a session's model, read as a decision, with a few lookups that only read (emacs_eval's speed judge, event watches). |
| [linking](linking.md) | by default | [session](session.md) | Links in what agents write: sessions, messages, tool calls, tasks and review threads, found and written out in full, and taught to agents in the system prompt. |
| [merge](merge.md) |  | [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md) | Merge queue: worktree branches merged into the session they were built on, or into the main checkout. |
| [naming](naming.md) | by default | [session](session.md), [provider](provider.md), [agent](agent.md) | Name nameless sessions with a cheap model as soon as their first message is sent. |
| [notifications](notifications.md) |  |  | Notifications for the user through pluggable providers: desktop (system) and Gotify. |
| [patch-review](patch-review.md) |  | [store](store.md), [tasks](tasks.md), [tools-review](tools-review.md) | The threads of a task's review: kept in the state directory, delivered with the feedback, answered by the agent. |
| [perms](perms.md) | by default | [config](config.md), [tools](tools.md) | Directory jail, directory requests, sandbox guard, permission modes, auto judge, user prompts and the user's approval of denied calls. |
| [pet](pet.md) |  | [store](store.md), [provider](provider.md) | A companion pet: hatched with random bones, named and voiced by a cheap model, growing with use. |
| [plugins](plugins.md) |  | [session](session.md) | Projects' plugins: what a project's trusted .dir-locals.el loads, and the plugin modules each session froze. |
| [priority](priority.md) | by default |  | Session priority (a task's is its session's): low, medium or high, and the one vocabulary for it. |
| [project](project.md) | by default |  | Project roots and non-blocking file lists (harness-files.el). |
| [provider](provider.md) | by default |  | Provider contract, registry and model catalogue. |
| [provider-bedrock](provider-bedrock.md) |  | [provider](provider.md) | AWS Bedrock provider: the Converse API, signed with SigV4 or an API key. |
| [provider-claude](provider-claude.md) | by default | [provider](provider.md) | Claude Code CLI as a hosted-loop completion provider. |
| [provider-copilot](provider-copilot.md) |  | [provider](provider.md) | GitHub Copilot CLI as a hosted-loop completion provider. |
| [provider-deepseek](provider-deepseek.md) |  | [provider](provider.md), [provider-openai](provider-openai.md) | DeepSeek provider (OpenAI-compatible) with peak and off-peak pricing. |
| [provider-demo](provider-demo.md) |  | [provider](provider.md) | Scripted provider for demos and tests. |
| [provider-openai](provider-openai.md) |  | [provider](provider.md) | OpenAI-compatible chat completions provider (OpenAI, OpenRouter, local servers). |
| [readonly](readonly.md) | by default | [session](session.md), [tools](tools.md) | Read-only sessions: the sessions a module's policy names (a supervisor, a task's write-up or plan) get only reading tools and read-only, offline bash, enforced by the harness. |
| [recap](recap.md) |  | [session](session.md), [provider](provider.md), [agent](agent.md), [tasks](tasks.md) | Write the recaps task cards show, with a short model call. |
| [redact](redact.md) |  | [secrets](secrets.md), [session](session.md), [store](store.md) | Takes a secret out of the transcripts and every other copy the harness keeps. |
| [resilience](resilience.md) | by default | [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md), [tools](tools.md) | Carry on sessions a stopped harness cut short, answer sub-agents' unanswered prompts by default, and report stalled turns. |
| [retry](retry.md) | by default | [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md) | Try a step again after a transient network or rate-limit failure. |
| [sandbox](sandbox.md) | by default | [config](config.md) | Kernel sandbox (bwrap / systemd-run / MXC on macOS) for spawned tool processes. |
| [secrets](secrets.md) |  | [store](store.md) | Secret references, masking of tool output and the guard against writing placeholders. |
| [seed](seed.md) |  | [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md) | Seed sessions: forks onto a model that share one warm prompt cache. |
| [session](session.md) | by default | [store](store.md), [project](project.md) | Session records, conversation DAG, queue and pending requests. |
| [session-search](session-search.md) |  | [store](store.md), [session](session.md) | Searches session transcripts: an SQLite full-text index, grep, and semantic search by embeddings. |
| [skills](skills.md) |  | [tools](tools.md) | Skill discovery (SKILL.md directories), search, loading and prompt index. |
| [store](store.md) | by default |  | JSON, JSONL and SQLite persistence under the state directory. |
| [supervisor](supervisor.md) |  | [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md), [tools](tools.md), [readonly](readonly.md) | Supervisor mode: sessions that plan and delegate, enforced by the harness. |
| [tasks](tasks.md) |  | [store](store.md), [project](project.md), [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md) | Task mode: one session per task, through review and the merge queue, with a limit of tasks at once per project, started by priority. |
| [tasks-notify](tasks-notify.md) |  | [tasks](tasks.md), [notifications](notifications.md) | Notifies you when a task's work waits for your review or a task is done (and, opt-in, when one needs your input). |
| [tasks-search](tasks-search.md) |  | [tasks](tasks.md), [provider](provider.md), [session-search](session-search.md) | Search the harness with a cheap model: tasks and actions on them, sessions, commands and an answer in words. |
| [tool-slots](tool-slots.md) |  | [tools](tools.md) | A few slots per machine for the tools that start processes. |
| [tool-slots-load](tool-slots-load.md) |  | [tool-slots](tool-slots.md) | Fewer tool slots while this machine is loaded. |
| [tools](tools.md) | by default |  | Tool registry, permission-gated execution and context-bomb guard. |
| [tools-agent](tools-agent.md) | by default | [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md) | The Sub-agent tool (spawn_agent), and the Planning section of the system prompt. |
| [tools-compact](tools-compact.md) |  | [tools](tools.md), [compaction](compaction.md) | The compact tool: an agent compacts its own conversation, on a running turn by queueing it or interrupting it. |
| [tools-emacs](tools-emacs.md) | by default | [tools](tools.md) | List buffers, List windows, Read buffer, Open buffer, Insert text, Save buffer, Describe symbol, Find definition, Trace symbol and Emacs messages: bounded tools into the user's Emacs, without evaluation. |
| [tools-emacs-eval](tools-emacs-eval.md) |  | [tools](tools.md) | Evaluate in Emacs: run Lisp in the user's Emacs when a judge model expects the code to return at once, unless the user turned it off (`harness-emacs-eval`). |
| [tools-events](tools-events.md) |  | [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md), [tools-sessions](tools-sessions.md) | watch_events and unwatch_events: a session watches harness events, and a cheap model decides which call for it to act. |
| [tools-fs](tools-fs.md) | by default | [tools](tools.md) | Read file, Write file, Edit file, List directory, Find files, Search files and File info. |
| [tools-handin](tools-handin.md) |  | [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md) | The hand_in tool: a task session hands its finished work in and stops. |
| [tools-notify](tools-notify.md) |  | [tools](tools.md), [notifications](notifications.md) | Notification and Notification providers: agents reach the user through the notifications module. |
| [tools-plan](tools-plan.md) | by default | [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md) | The Plan tool: record a plan for a complex task, shown to the user. |
| [tools-question](tools-question.md) | by default | [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md) | The Question tool (ask_user), and the questions the harness asks the user itself. |
| [tools-review](tools-review.md) |  | [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md) | The review_threads and review_comment tools: a task's agent reads and answers the threads of its review. |
| [tools-session-info](tools-session-info.md) | by default | [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md) | The Session info tool (session_info): the current session, described to the model. |
| [tools-sessions](tools-sessions.md) |  | [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md), [agent](agent.md) | Tools to list, search, read, message, control, move and wait on sessions and tasks. |
| [tools-shell](tools-shell.md) | by default | [tools](tools.md) | Bash (asynchronous, sandboxed when available) and Emacs Lisp evaluation. |
| [tools-ssh](tools-ssh.md) |  | [tools](tools.md), [tools-shell](tools-shell.md) | SSH: shell commands on another host, through TRAMP. |
| [tools-todo](tools-todo.md) | by default | [tools](tools.md), [session](session.md) | The Todo list tool (todo_write): the session's todo list. |
| [tools-web](tools-web.md) |  | [tools](tools.md) | Web search (pluggable providers, Brave built in; else the model provider's own search) and Fetch page (rendered with shr). |
| [usage](usage.md) | by default | [store](store.md), [session](session.md), [provider](provider.md) | Cost accounting, usage summaries, budgets, output rates and live token counts. |
| [version](version.md) |  |  | Whether the running harness is the latest: its commit against its origins. |
| [worktree](worktree.md) | by default | [project](project.md) | Git worktree listing, creation, locking, removal and status. |

## Events

An event reaches the UI modules when the ACP server forwards it (the
column "To the UI"); they hear it through `harness-ui-event-functions`.

| Event | Declared by | Emitted by | Handled by | To the UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `*` |  |  | [acp](acp.md) |  |
| `access/changed` | [access](access.md) | [access](access.md) |  | yes |
| `access/judged` | [access](access.md) | [access](access.md) |  | yes |
